supports: On this fixed LLY Item 1A pair, protocol structure materially changes first-read usefulness, specificity, novelty separation, and auditability.
The primary read is the clearest first read because it keeps the filing delta legible while staying contract-bounded and paragraph-addressable.
Holding the tagged substrate fixed shows that protocol changes alone can materially alter which obesity-access, pricing, and concentration risks lead the narrative.
A bounded Fresh vs reused view now transfers across vivid and restraint cases without promoting it to an equal top-level read.
does_not_yet_support: This is a bounded case view and does not yet generalize across companies or establish a benchmark-grade leaderboard.
It is not a final proof of universal superiority of one protocol outside the fixed filing pair and the current limited visible case mix.
It does not yet cover whole-filing context, external research overlays, a full lower-audit stack for every case, or equal-weight promotion of Fresh vs reused.
why_02_is_hero: The primary read stays first because it best surfaces what changed in Lilly's filing while keeping the output structured, specific, and easy to audit against the tagged packet.
why_03_is_main_comparator: The comparison read uses the same i2 tagged substrate as the primary read, making protocol framing the main variable under comparison.
why_00_is_control: The control read uses the same tagged substrate as the primary read without the canonical structured contract, and its recovered status keeps the baseline honest.
why_01_is_secondary: No clean traceable reuse-filtered read exists for LLY in this wave, so the comparison intentionally stops at the primary read, comparison read, and recovered control.
